query: I finally got around to planting those tomato seedlings I bought last week, and I was so excited to see the first little sprout pop up yesterday, I even took a dozen photos to send to my mom. My neighbor also gave me a homemade jar of pickled cucumbers the other day, it’s so tangy and crisp I’ve already eaten half of it with my lunch. Oh, and my cat knocked over my favorite ceramic mug this morning, luckily it didn’t shatter, just chipped a tiny bit on the rim, I’m still sad about it though. I need to exchange some delivered order items: for order #W4689314, I want to exchange item 5996159312 for item 8363011723, and for order #W3916020, I want to exchange items 7758198585 and 4068787148 for items 5606522780 and 5546244844.
